773.flavorTextJa: ダイマックスした ポケモンが 繰りだす くさタイプの 攻撃。 ５ターンの 間 グラスフィールドにする。

774.name: Max Steelspike
774.shortEffect: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
774.flavorTextJa: ダイマックスした ポケモンが 繰りだす はがねタイプの 攻撃。 味方の 防御を 上げる。

775.name: Clangorous Soul
775.shortEffect: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
775.flavorTextJa: 自分の ＨＰを 少し 削って すべての 能力を 上げる。

776.name: Body Press
776.shortEffect: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
776.flavorTextJa: 体を ぶつけて 攻撃。 防御が 高いほど 与える ダメージが 増える。

777.name: Decorate
777.shortEffect: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
777.flavorTextJa: かざりつけを することで 相手の 攻撃と 特攻を ぐーんと 上げる。

778.name: Drum Beating
778.shortEffect: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
778.flavorTextJa: ドラムの 根っこを ドラミングで コントロールして こうげき することで 相手の 素早さを 下げる。

779.name: Snap Trap
779.shortEffect: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
779.flavorTextJa: トラバサミで 捕らえて ４－５ターンの 間 相手を はさんで 攻撃する。

780.name: Pyro Ball
780.shortEffect: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
780.flavorTextJa: 小石を 燃やした 炎の ボールで 相手を 攻撃する。 やけど 状態に することが ある。

781.name: Behemoth Blade
781.shortEffect: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
781.flavorTextJa: 巨大な 剣となり 切りかかる。 相手が ダイマックス していると ダメージは ２倍に なる。

782.name: Behemoth Bash
782.shortEffect: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
782.flavorTextJa: 巨大な 盾となり ぶつかる。 相手が ダイマックス していると ダメージは ２倍に なる。

783.name: Aura Wheel
783.shortEffect: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
783.flavorTextJa: ほほぶくろに 溜めた エネルギーで 攻撃し 自分の 素早さを あげる。 モルペコの 姿で タイプが 変わる。

784.name: Breaking Swipe
784.shortEffect: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
784.flavorTextJa: きょうじんな しっぽを 激しく ふりはらって 相手を 攻撃する。 相手の 攻撃を 下げる。

785.name: Branch Poke
785.shortEffect: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.
785.flavorTextJa: するどく とがった 枝で 相手を 突いて 攻撃する。

786.name: Overdrive
786.shortEffect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.
786.flavorTextJa: ギターや ベースを かきならして 激しく 響く 大きな 振動を 相手に 与えて 攻撃する。

787.name: Apple Acid
787.shortEffect: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
787.flavorTextJa: すっぱい りんごから つくりだした 酸性の 液体で 攻撃。 相手の 特防を 下げる。

788.name: Grav Apple
788.shortEffect: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
788.flavorTextJa: 高いところから りんごを 落として ダメージを 与える。 相手の 防御を 下げる。

789.name: Spirit Break
789.shortEffect: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
789.flavorTextJa: 食らうと くじけるほどの 勢いで 攻撃。 相手の 特攻を 下げる。

790.name: Strange Steam
790.shortEffect: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
790.flavorTextJa: 煙を 噴出して 相手を 攻撃。 混乱 させることが ある。

791.name: Life Dew
791.shortEffect: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
791.flavorTextJa: 不思議な 水を ふりまいて 自分と 場にいる 味方の ＨＰを 回復する。

792.name: Obstruct
792.shortEffect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.
792.flavorTextJa: 相手の 攻撃を まったく 受けない。 連続で だすと 失敗しやすい。 触れると 防御が がくっと 下がる。

793.name: False Surrender
793.shortEffect: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
793.flavorTextJa: 頭を 下げる ふりを しながら 振りみだした 髪の毛を 突き刺す。 攻撃は 必ず 命中する。

794.name: Meteor Assault
794.shortEffect: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
794.flavorTextJa: 太い クキを ふりまわして 攻撃。 ただし 自分も よろめいてしまうため 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。

795.name: Eternabeam
795.shortEffect: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
795.flavorTextJa: 本来の 姿と なった ムゲンダイナ 最大の 攻撃。 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。

796.name: Steel Beam
796.shortEffect: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
796.flavorTextJa: 全身から 集めた はがねを ビームとして 激しく 撃ちだす。 自分も ダメージを 受けてしまう。

797.name: Expanding Force
797.shortEffect: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
797.flavorTextJa: サイコパワーで 相手を 攻撃する。 サイコフィールドの時 威力が あがり すべての 相手に ダメージを 与える。

798.name: Steel Roller
798.shortEffect: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
798.flavorTextJa: フィールドを 破壊しながら 攻撃。 なんらかの フィールド状態に 変わっていないと 技は 失敗する。

799.name: Scale Shot
799.shortEffect: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
799.flavorTextJa: ウロコを 撃ちだして 攻撃する。 ２ー５回の 間 連続で だす。 素早さが あがるが 防御が さがる。

800.name: Meteor Beam
800.shortEffect: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
800.flavorTextJa: １ターン目に 宇宙の 力を 集めることで 特攻が あがり ２ターン目に 相手を 攻撃する。

801.name: Shell Side Arm
801.shortEffect: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.
801.flavorTextJa: 物理か 特殊か より多く ダメージを 与えられる 能力で 攻撃する。 毒状態に することが ある。

802.name: Misty Explosion
802.shortEffect: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
802.flavorTextJa: 自分の 周りに いる すべてを 攻撃するが 使うと 瀕死になる。 ミストフィールドで 威力が あがる。

803.name: Grassy Glide
803.shortEffect: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
803.flavorTextJa: 地面を 滑るように 相手を 攻撃。 グラスフィールドの時 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。

804.name: Rising Voltage
804.shortEffect: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
804.flavorTextJa: 地面から 立ちのぼる 電撃で 攻撃。 相手が エレキフィールドに いる時 技の 威力が ２倍に なる。

805.name: Terrain Pulse
805.shortEffect: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
805.flavorTextJa: フィールドの力を 借りて 攻撃。 使った時の フィールドの状態に よって 技の タイプと 威力が 変わる。

806.name: Skitter Smack
806.shortEffect: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
806.flavorTextJa: 背後から はいより 攻撃する。 相手の 特攻を さげる。

807.name: Burning Jealousy
807.shortEffect: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
807.flavorTextJa: しっとの エネルギーで 相手を 攻撃。 そのターン 能力が あがった ポケモンを やけどの 状態に する。

808.name: Lash Out
808.shortEffect: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
808.flavorTextJa: 相手への いらだちを ぶつけて 攻撃。 そのターンに 能力を さげられていると 技の 威力が ２倍に なる。

809.name: Poltergeist
809.shortEffect: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
809.flavorTextJa: 相手の 持ち物を あやつって 攻撃。 相手が 道具を 持っていない 場合は 失敗する。

810.name: Corrosive Gas
810.shortEffect: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
810.flavorTextJa: 強い 酸性の ガスで 周りに いるものを 包みこみ 持っている 道具を 溶かしてしまう。

811.name: Coaching
811.shortEffect: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
811.flavorTextJa: 的確な 指導を おこなうことで 味方 全員の 攻撃と 防御を 上げる。

812.name: Flip Turn
812.shortEffect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
812.flavorTextJa: 攻撃した あと ものすごい スピードで 戻ってきて 控えの ポケモンと 入れ替わる。

813.name: Triple Axel
813.shortEffect: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
813.flavorTextJa: ３回連続で キックを くりだして 攻撃する。 技が 当たるたびに 威力は あがる。

814.name: Dual Wingbeat
814.shortEffect: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
814.flavorTextJa: 翼を 相手に ぶつけて 攻撃する。 ２回連続で ダメージを 与える。

815.name: Scorching Sands
815.shortEffect: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
815.flavorTextJa: 熱く 焼けた 砂を 相手に ぶつけて 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。

816.name: Jungle Healing
816.shortEffect: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
816.flavorTextJa: ジャングルと 一体化して 自分と 場にいる 味方の ＨＰと 状態を 回復する。

817.name: Wicked Blow
817.shortEffect: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
817.flavorTextJa: あくの型を 極めし 強烈な 一撃。 必ず 急所に 当たる。

818.name: Surging Strikes
818.shortEffect: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.
818.flavorTextJa: みずの型を 極めし 流れるような ３回の 連撃。 必ず 急所に 当たる。

819.name: Thunder Cage
819.shortEffect: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
819.flavorTextJa: ほとばしる 電気の おりの 中に ４ー５ターンの 間 相手を 閉じこめて 攻撃する。

820.name: Dragon Energy
820.shortEffect: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
820.flavorTextJa: 生命力を パワーに 変え 相手を 攻撃する。 自分の ＨＰが 少ないほど 技の 威力は さがる。

821.name: Freezing Glare
821.shortEffect: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
821.flavorTextJa: 両目から サイコパワーを 撃ちだして 攻撃する。 こおり状態に することが ある。

822.name: Fiery Wrath
822.shortEffect: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.
822.flavorTextJa: 怒りを 炎の ような オーラに 変えて 攻撃する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。

823.name: Thunderous Kick
823.shortEffect: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
823.flavorTextJa: 雷の ような 動きで 相手を 翻弄しながら キックする。 相手の 防御を さげる。

824.name: Glacial Lance
824.shortEffect: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.
824.flavorTextJa: 吹雪を まとった 氷の 槍を 相手に 投げつけて 攻撃する。

825.name: Astral Barrage
825.shortEffect: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.
825.flavorTextJa: たくさんの 小さな 霊体を 相手に ぶつけて 攻撃する。

826.name: Eerie Spell
826.shortEffect: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
826.flavorTextJa: 強力な サイコパワーで 攻撃。 相手が 最後に 使った技の ＰＰを ３だけ 減らす。

827.name: Dire Claw
827.shortEffect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

828.name: Psyshield Bash
828.shortEffect: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

829.name: Power Shift
829.shortEffect: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

830.name: Stone Axe
830.shortEffect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

831.name: Springtide Storm
831.shortEffect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

832.name: Mystical Power
832.shortEffect: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

833.name: Raging Fury
833.shortEffect: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

834.name: Wave Crash
834.shortEffect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

835.name: Chloroblast
835.shortEffect: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

836.name: Mountain Gale
836.shortEffect: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

837.name: Victory Dance
837.shortEffect: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

838.name: Headlong Rush
838.shortEffect: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

839.name: Barb Barrage
839.shortEffect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

840.name: Esper Wing
840.shortEffect: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

841.name: Bitter Malice
841.shortEffect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

842.name: Shelter
842.shortEffect: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

843.name: Triple Arrows
843.shortEffect: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

844.name: Infernal Parade
844.shortEffect: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

845.name: Ceaseless Edge
845.shortEffect: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

846.name: Bleakwind Storm
846.shortEffect: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

847.name: Wildbolt Storm
847.shortEffect: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

848.name: Sandsear Storm
848.shortEffect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

849.name: Lunar Blessing
849.shortEffect: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

850.name: Take Heart
850.shortEffect: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

851.name: Tera Blast
851.shortEffect: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

852.name: Silk Trap
852.shortEffect: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

853.name: Axe Kick
853.shortEffect: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

854.name: Last Respects
854.shortEffect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

855.name: Lumina Crash
855.shortEffect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

856.name: Order Up
856.shortEffect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

857.name: Jet Punch
857.shortEffect: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

858.name: Spicy Extract
858.shortEffect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

859.name: Spin Out
859.shortEffect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

860.name: Population Bomb
860.shortEffect: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

861.name: Ice Spinner
861.shortEffect: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

862.name: Glaive Rush
862.shortEffect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

863.name: Revival Blessing
863.shortEffect: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

864.name: Salt Cure
864.shortEffect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

865.name: Triple Dive
865.shortEffect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

866.name: Mortal Spin
866.shortEffect: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

867.name: Doodle
867.shortEffect: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

868.name: Fillet Away
868.shortEffect: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

869.name: Kowtow Cleave
869.shortEffect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

870.name: Flower Trick
870.shortEffect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

871.name: Torch Song
871.shortEffect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

872.name: Aqua Step
872.shortEffect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

873.name: Raging Bull
873.shortEffect: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

874.name: Make It Rain
874.shortEffect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

875.name: Psyblade
875.shortEffect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

876.name: Hydro Steam
876.shortEffect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

877.name: Ruination
877.shortEffect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

878.name: Collision Course
878.shortEffect: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

879.name: Electro Drift
879.shortEffect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

880.name: Shed Tail
880.shortEffect: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

881.name: Chilly Reception
881.shortEffect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

882.name: Tidy Up
882.shortEffect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

883.name: Snowscape
883.shortEffect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

884.name: Pounce
884.shortEffect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

885.name: Trailblaze
885.shortEffect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

886.name: Chilling Water
886.shortEffect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

887.name: Hyper Drill
887.shortEffect: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

888.name: Twin Beam
888.shortEffect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

889.name: Rage Fist
889.shortEffect: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

890.name: Armor Cannon
890.shortEffect: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

891.name: Bitter Blade
891.shortEffect: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

892.name: Double Shock
892.shortEffect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

893.name: Gigaton Hammer
893.shortEffect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

894.name: Comeuppance
894.shortEffect: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

895.name: Aqua Cutter
895.shortEffect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

901.name: Blood Moon
901.shortEffect: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

902.name: Matcha Gotcha
902.shortEffect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

903.name: Syrup Bomb
903.shortEffect: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

904.name: Ivy Cudgel
904.shortEffect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

905.name: Electro Shot
905.shortEffect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

906.name: Tera Starstorm
906.shortEffect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

907.name: Fickle Beam
907.shortEffect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

908.name: Burning Bulwark
908.shortEffect: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

909.name: Thunderclap
909.shortEffect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

910.name: Mighty Cleave
910.shortEffect: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

911.name: Tachyon Cutter
911.shortEffect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

912.name: Hard Press
912.shortEffect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

913.name: Dragon Cheer
913.shortEffect: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

914.name: Alluring Voice
914.shortEffect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

915.name: Temper Flare
915.shortEffect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

916.name: Supercell Slam
916.shortEffect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

917.name: Psychic Noise
917.shortEffect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

918.name: Upper Hand
918.shortEffect: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

919.name: Malignant Chain
919.shortEffect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
